title: COLLECTION OF GAME OF THRONES ...
reason: Large set of about 32 Game of Thrones collector figures with three branded display stands sold as one lot, a collectable licensed range with a ready resale market.
findings: Six photos viewed. About 30 painted figures of Game of Thrones characters on round silver-effect bases with a chain-link pattern, displayed on three moulded grey two-tier display stands (10 figures each) with 'GAME OF THRONES' and house sigil panels moulded along the front. Photo 6 shows one further figure still boxed in a black and gold card box with a clear blister (a Ned Stark type figure), and photo 5 a loose Jon Snow in Night's Watch dress, so about 32 figures in all. Characters include Daenerys, Cersei, Sansa, Margaery, Jon Snow, a Dothraki warrior, a White Walker and many others. The base style and stands look like the licensed collector figure range (Eaglemoss type), but no maker's name, copyright line or serial number is legible in the photos, so that is unconfirmed. The title (collection of Game of Thrones figurines) is supported, and the lot is large and well presented.
condition: Figures look clean and complete, and thin swords and spears appear straight. Stands look intact with no visible breaks. Small accessories cannot all be checked. One figure is still boxed, the rest are loose.
rescore_note: About 32 painted Game of Thrones collector figures (Eaglemoss chess collection type, unconfirmed) with three licensed display stands, one still boxed, clean and complete looking; a big licensed set with an established resale market. Judged $200 to $500 band. Not price-checked (search limit hit).
